paite: Pathian aw, na vaihawmnate kumpipa kiang ah pia inla, na diktatna kumpipa tapa kiang ah pia in.
heading: Solomon La / Kumpipa Thumna

paite: Na mite dikna in vai ahawmsak ding a, na mi gentheite vaihawmna dik in vai ahawmsak ding hi.
Tang lian leh mual neute'n diktatna in mite kiang ah khamuanna ahon tun ding uhi.
Ama'n mi lak a gentheite vai ahawmsak ding a, tagah tate ahondam ding a, nuaisiahtu bel ahihzan ding hi.
Tung a ni leh kha om sung teng, suan om sung teng in leng akikou ding uhi.
Amah loupa gawitan tung a vuah kia bang in ake ding a; lei vak vuahtui bang mai in.
Adam lai un midiktat ahampha ding uh, khapi om nawn louh dong in khamuanna thupi toh akhang ding uhi.
Ama'n tuipi a pan a tuipi dang pha in, luipi a pan kawlmong pha in thu anei ding.
Gamdai a omte ama ah akun ding ua, amelmate'n leng leivui aliak ding uhi.
Tarshish gam leh tuikulh gam kumpipate'n kipahman ahon tawi ding ua; Sheba leh Seba gam Kumpipate'n thilpiakte ahon lan ding uhi.
Ahi, kumpipa tengteng ama ah abokkhup ding ua, nam chih teng in a-nna asem ding uhi.
Genthei in asap chiang in ama'n ahumbit ding a, mitagah, panpihpa nei lou leng ahumbit ding hi.
Migenthei leh tagahte ahehpih ding a, tagahte hinna ahondam ding hi.
Ahinna uh nuaisiahna leh hiamgamna lak a kipan atan ding a, asisan uh amah ngaihdan in manphatak ahi ding hi.
Huan ahing ding a; Sheba gam dangka-eng a kipan a piak ahi ding a, mite'n amah athumsak gige ding ua; niteng in phat in a-om ding hi.
Lei ah, mualvum peuh ah, buh tampi a-om ding a; avui Lebanon bang in aling suausuau ding a, khua a mite bel loupa bang in apha lihliah ding uhi.
Amin tangtawn in a-omden ding a; amin nisa a-om sung in tatlak lou in a-om zel ding a; mite amah ah vualzawl in a-om ding ua; nam chihte'n amah hampha achi ding uh.
TOUPA Pathian, Israel' Pathian phat in om hen, amah kia in thillamdang ahih zel a.
Amin thupitak tangtawn in phat in leng om henla; leitung pumpi leng athupina a hihdim in om hen. Amen, Amen.
Jesse tapa David thumnate abeita hi.
